title: Confinement and orbital stability of solitons of the NLS equation on metric graphs
summary: We study the behavior of soliton states for the subcritical, time-dependent focusing NLS equation on a large family of non-compact metric graphs with Kirchhoff boundary conditions. This family is characterized by a topological assumption (``Assumption H'' in the literature) which rules out the existence of a ground state for all members of the class, with a single exception: the bubble-tower metric graph.
